title: Filter rows with WHERE
description: Write a query that returns the `name` and `price` of every product in the `products` table with a `price` greater than 30.
hints: WHERE condition filters rows before they're returned - only rows where the condition is true make it into the result, the same idea as an `if` check applied to every row.
Add WHERE price > 30 after FROM products, and select name and price.
expected_behavior: Returns name and price for products priced above 30.
solution: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 30;
explanation: WHERE runs before the columns are selected, conceptually - it decides which rows survive, and comparison operators like > work on numeric columns exactly as you'd expect.
